messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: added function multiply_lower_tri_self_transpose
parts:
The name's a mouthful, but the behavior is simple:

multiply_lower_tri_self_transpose(L)

= lower_tri(L) * lower_tri(L)'

where lower_tri(L) is the lower triangular portion of
L including the diagonal (thus the strictly upper
triangular portion of input L is ignored even if it
is nonzero).

I added some constructors to the dot_self_vari
and dot_product_vari in order to be able to share
variables in the dot products.

I tested values and gradients vs. the direct
implementation in Eigen, and everything looks good.

I didn't replace anything in the rest of the code
where this might get used, but I did add it to
function_signatures so you can use it in models and
also added it to the doc.

- Bob
